facts.fact: The ministers launched APIM digital services on 4 April 2025 letting investors create companies online through the 'Mes services' portal.
Company creation through the portal yields a commerce register entry, a tax registration and social security (CNSS) affiliation in a single procedure.

systems.platform: mobile app and portal (App Store, Play Store)
systems.tiers: sign-in verified through the Mon Identité app
